tests.description: Verify FX lock at initiation, credit before debit, rollback after a 5 second timeout, and second-owner approval before settlement
steps: Start a wallet top-up above SGD 10,000
Verify the FX rate is locked at the moment the top-up is initiated
Verify the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited
Verify that when the provider callback times out after 5 seconds, the transaction is rolled back and neither side is affected
Verify a second business owner must approve before the top-up settles
tests.expectedResult: The FX rate remains the rate locked at initiation, the wallet is credited before the funding source is debited, a timeout after 5 seconds leaves neither side affected, and a top-up above SGD 10,000 does not settle until a second business owner approves
